data.body: RCA hypothesis/confirmation: the test uses threads to model contention, but POSIX flock semantics are process-associated/platform-dependent for same-process descriptors. On Linux the second thread can take the marker lock while the first thread still holds its critical section, so the test oracle permits second-done before first-done. A control probe using separate processes preserves the intended cross-process serialization (before release only first-has-lock; after release first-done then second-done). Root cause is the test harness using same-process threads for a process-level lock contract; production cross-process locking remains correct.
